about: Field-policy classification manifest. One entry per column of each classified record type. The gate (scripts/verify/field-policy-census.mjs) requires the migrated schema's columns of these tables, and the baseline rows of public.field_policies, to equal this file exactly. See README.md.
flags: Each surface value is three characters in the order visible, editable, exportable: 'v', 'e' or 'x' where the surface admits the operation, '-' where it does not.

receipts.reason: Canonical receipts are reserved for Phase 7. No public.receipts relation may exist and no field may be classified under this record type.

gift_receipt_records.reason: Prototype receipt relation. It may exist, and it receives no field-policy rows or authority.

contribution_receipt_snapshots.reason: Prototype receipt relation. It may exist, and it receives no field-policy rows or authority.

pinned_sources.reason: Defines donors.email_normalized and donors.email_verified_at and seeds their rows (census supplement v2, #2254).
The merged person-anchor migration of #2256 (census supplement v3). AL-2678 drops the table and the two columns it defined; the pin keeps the merged file as it was merged.
